result.summary: 本文训练了一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，并在不进行任何梯度更新或微调的情况下，以零样本、单样本和少样本方式在大量 NLP 任务上进行评估 [abstract][S1.p9]。作者发现扩大模型规模能大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能，部分任务上接近甚至达到此前最先进微调方法的水平 [abstract]。GPT-3 在翻译、问答、完形填空以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务上表现较强，但在部分数据集上仍然吃力，并存在与大规模网络语料训练相关的方法学问题 [abstract]。作者还发现 GPT-3 生成的新闻文章样本让人类评估者难以与人类撰写的文章区分 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调的范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要针对每个任务准备数千到数十万个样本的微调数据集 [S1.p2]。作者希望去除这一限制，测试扩大语言模型规模能否提升任务无关的少样本性能 [S1.p2][S1.p9]。作者指出，此前元学习等方法结果远逊于微调，例如在 Natural Questions 上仅达到 4%，因此需要大幅改进才能成为实用的语言任务求解方法 [S1.p7]。

evidence.quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
Removing this limitation would be desirable, for several reasons.
In this paper, we test this hypothesis by training a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model, which we call GPT-3, and measuring its in-context learning abilities.
this approach still achieves results far inferior to fine-tuning – for example achieves only 4% on Natural Questions
Meta-learning clearly requires substantial improvement in order to be viable as a practical method of solving language tasks.

method.text: 论文训练了一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，其参数量是此前任何非稀疏语言模型的 10 倍 [abstract]。评估时 GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]。对每个任务，作者在三种条件下评估：少样本（允许尽可能多的示例放入上下文窗口，通常 10 到 100 个）、单样本（仅一个示例）和零样本（不给示例，只给自然语言指令）[S1.p9]。少样本评估时，从该任务的训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件 [S2.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model.
we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”, or in-context learning where we allow as many demonstrations as will fit into the model’s context window (typically 10 to 100)
(b) “one-shot learning”, where we allow only one demonstration, and (c) “zero-shot” learning, where no demonstrations are allowed and only an instruction in natural language is given to the model.
we evaluate each example in the evaluation set by randomly drawing $K$ examples from that task’s training set as conditioning

experiments.text: 作者在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应能力而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，覆盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 式任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE 和 NLI 等 [S1.p9][S3.p3]。评估在零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置下进行 [S3.p3]。在 SuperGLUE 上，少样本设置对所有任务使用 32 个从训练集随机抽取的示例 [S3.SS7.p1]。作者还设计了合成任务来探测即时推理能力，包括算术、单词字母重排、SAT 类比以及使用新词造句、纠正英语语法和新闻文章生成等定性任务 [S3.SS9.p1]。

evidence.quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation to tasks unlikely to be directly contained in the training set
We evaluate all tasks in the few-shot, one-shot, and zero-shot settings.
In the few-shot setting, we used 32 examples for all tasks, sampled randomly from the training set.
First, we test GPT-3’s ability to perform arithmetic. Second, we create several tasks that involve rearranging or unscrambling the letters in a word
Finally, we test GPT-3 on several qualitative tasks, including using new words in a sentence, correcting English grammar, and news article generation.

findings.text: GPT-3 在多个任务上取得较强性能：在 PTB 上以 20.50 的困惑度刷新 SOTA，领先 15 个点 [S3.SS1.SSS1.p1]；在 LAMBADA 上少样本能力带来大幅准确率提升，GPT-3 175B 将 SOTA 提升 18% [S3.F2]；在 TriviaQA 上零样本达到 64.3%，已超过微调的 T5-11B 14.2% [S3.SS2.p2]。在 HellaSwag 上，GPT-3 单样本达到 78.1%、少样本达到 79.3%，超过微调的 15 亿参数语言模型的 75.4%，但仍低于微调多任务模型 ALUM 的 85.6% [S3.SS1.SSS3.p1]。在 CoQA 上 GPT-3 175B 少样本达到 85 F1，仅落后人类基线和最先进微调模型几个点 [S3.F7]。同时，作者发现部分任务即使在该规模下少样本表现仍吃力，包括 ANLI、RACE 和 QuAC 等 [S1.p13]。在新闻文章生成上，人类识别模型生成文章的准确率从对照模型的 86% 降至 GPT-3 175B 的 52% [S3.T11]。

evidence.quote: Our largest model sets a new SOTA on PTB by a substantial margin of 15 points, achieving a perplexity of 20.50.
GPT-3 175B advances the state of the art by 18%
On TriviaQA, we achieve 64.3% in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting.
The zero-shot result already outperforms the fine-tuned T5-11B by 14.2%
GPT-3 achieves 78.1% accuracy in the one-shot setting and 79.3% accuracy in the few-shot setting, outperforming the 75.4% accuracy of a fine-tuned 1.5B parameter language model
still a fair amount lower than the overall SOTA of 85.6% achieved by the fine-tuned multi-task model ALUM
GPT-3 175B achieves 85 F1 in the few-shot setting, only a few points behind measured human performance and state-of-the-art fine-tuned models.
This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
human accuracy (measured by the ratio of correct assignments to non-neutral assignments) ranges from 86% on the control model to 52% on GPT-3 175B

limitations.text: 作者指出 GPT-3 存在若干结构性局限：实验只包含自回归模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能解释了 GPT-3 在 WIC、ANLI 以及 QuAC、RACE 等任务上少样本表现落后 [S5.p3]。另一个局限是预训练阶段的样本效率较差，GPT-3 在预训练中看到的文本仍远多于人类一生所见 [S5.p5]。少样本学习存在不确定性：不清楚它是在推理时真正“从零”学习新任务，还是仅仅识别出训练中已学过的任务 [S5.p6]。此外，GPT-3 规模的模型推理既昂贵又不方便，可能对实际应用构成挑战 [S5.p7]。作者还指出数据污染分析的一个重要局限：无法确定干净子集与原数据集来自同一分布 [S4.p10]。

evidence.quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
This could be a possible explanation for GPT-3’s lagging few-shot performance on a few of the tasks, such as WIC
it still sees much more text during pre-training than a human sees in the their lifetime
ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training
they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on, which may present a challenge for practical applicability of models of this scale in their current form
we cannot be sure that the clean subset is drawn from the same distribution as the original dataset
